general.env.lead: Read-only. Change it in the compose file, then restart.
general.env.title: Set through the environment
general.env_invalid: :env holds a value this setting does not accept. It is ignored.
general.env_invalid_backups: :env holds a value this setting does not accept. tesserarr:migrate refuses to run until it is fixed or removed.
general.hint.backups_keep: Default 5, from 1 to 50. tesserarr:migrate keeps this many.
general.hint.display_name: Shown in the header and on the sign-in page.
general.hint.invitation_days: Default 7. Can be changed when inviting.
general.hint.locale: Applies until somebody chooses another language in My account.
general.hint.page_size: Entries per request, in the catalogue too. Default 50.
general.hint.theme: Applies until somebody chooses another in My account.
general.hint.time_zone: IANA name, for example Europe/Berlin. Default UTC.
general.label.backups_keep: Backups to keep before a migration
general.lead: Name, language, time zone and defaults for this instance. The database, keys, platform URL and proxy addresses come from the environment.
general.logged: Every change goes into the audit log.
general.overridden: Overridden by the environment. Set through :env. Remove it to edit here.
general.request.title: How Tesserarr sees your request right now
general.saved: Saved. The change is in the audit log.

profile.description: Your username and the name others see
profile.username.hint: Lower case, 3 to 64 characters, no @. You sign in with it.

roles.danger.title: Danger zone
roles.delete_confirm.title: Delete the role “:role”?

roles.note.operator.body: The last active operator cannot be demoted, removed or locked.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
